serviceDetails.title: Is a gas cooker safe to fit?
paras: Yes, when a Gas Safe engineer fits it. A badly fitted cooker can leak gas, which puts your home at risk. We follow the correct steps on every job, from the connection to the final safety checks, so you can cook without worry.
serviceDetails.alt: Gas Safe engineer connecting a gas cooker in Watford

serviceDetails.title: What is included in a cooker fit?
paras: Every gas cooker or hob fit includes a full safety check and setup to ensure your kitchen is completely secure:
list: Checking the gas supply and space
Checking the flame on every burner
serviceDetails.alt: Engineer leak testing a gas cooker connection

serviceDetails.title: How quick is the fit?
paras: Most cooker fits take under an hour. Once we have tested every joint and checked the flame, your cooker is safe to use the same day. Book a time to suit you, including fits arranged around a new kitchen.
serviceDetails.alt: Gas cooker ready to use the same day

serviceDetails.title: Do you fit gas hobs and range cookers?
paras: Yes. We fit freestanding gas cookers, built in gas hobs, dual fuel cookers and range cookers. For built in hobs, we connect the gas once the hob is in the worktop. If the gas pipe needs moving or extending for a new kitchen layout, we can do this too.
serviceDetails.alt: Built in gas hob fitted in a kitchen worktop

serviceDetails.title: Can you disconnect my old cooker?
paras: Yes. We safely disconnect your old gas cooker, cap the gas supply if needed, and can take the old cooker away. If you are switching from gas to electric, we can cap the gas supply safely so it is left in a safe state.
serviceDetails.alt: Old gas cooker safely disconnected and removed

serviceDetails.title: Are your prices clear?
paras: Yes. You get a fixed price before we start, with no hidden extras. Tell us the make and model of your new cooker, and whether you need the old one removed, and we will give you a price.
serviceDetails.alt: Fixed price gas cooker installation quote

serviceDetails.title: Why choose AR Heating?
paras: We are a local Watford company, trading since 2007, and every gas job is done under our Gas Safe registration, No. 574111. We give you a fixed price before we start, turn up when we say we will, and leave your home as clean as we found it. If something is not worth doing, we tell you.
serviceDetails.alt: Gas Safe registered AR Heating engineer

serviceDetails.title: Why does ventilation matter?
paras: Gas cookers need fresh air to burn safely. Without enough ventilation, the flame can burn poorly and give off carbon monoxide. We check your kitchen has the right air supply for your cooker, and tell you if anything needs to change before we turn it on. We also recommend a carbon monoxide alarm in any room with a gas appliance.
serviceDetails.alt: Kitchen ventilation checked for a gas cooker

serviceDetails.title: What if my gas connection is old?
paras: Many older kitchens have a worn gas hose or a bayonet fitting which has seen better days. If your connection is not safe or is the wrong type for your new cooker, we replace it. We use parts made for gas cookers, and test the new connection before we leave.
serviceDetails.alt: Approved flexible gas hose for a cooker

We are Gas Safe registered (No. 574111), fully insured, and you can check our number on the Gas Safe Register before we arrive.

faqs.q: Can I fit a gas cooker myself?
faqs.a: No. By law, a gas cooker must be fitted by a Gas Safe registered engineer.

faqs.q: How long does the fit take?
faqs.a: Most fits take under an hour.
Yes. We test every joint before we leave.

faqs.q: Can I use the cooker the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. Once it is tested and safe, you can cook straight away.
Yes. We fit built in gas hobs, freestanding cookers, dual fuel and range cookers.

faqs.q: Can you take my old cooker away?
faqs.a: Yes. We can disconnect and remove your old cooker.

faqs.q: Can you move my gas pipe for a new kitchen?
faqs.a: Yes. We can move or extend the gas supply to suit your new layout.
Ask us for a record of the work when you book, and we will confirm what you will receive.

faqs.q: Do I need a carbon monoxide alarm?
faqs.a: We recommend one in any room with a gas appliance. It is a small cost for real peace of mind.

faqs.q: What if my old gas hose is worn?
faqs.a: We replace it with a new connection made for gas cookers and test it before we leave.

faqs.q: Can you fit a cooker I bought online?
faqs.a: Yes. We fit cookers and hobs bought from any shop, as long as the model is suitable for your gas supply.

faqs.q: Is a gas cooker cheaper to run than electric?
faqs.a: It depends on gas and electricity prices at the time. Many people choose gas for the instant heat control on the hob.
